API

For AI agents: this API as Markdown, or every component in llms-full.txt.

<ray-icon> · RayIcon

setIcons({ name: '<svg…>' }) replaces or adds icons (SVG markup or an SVGElement, drawn with currentColor); iconNames() lists them. An icon may have a filled version for a state (filled; "<name>:filled" in setIcons; iconNames({ filled: true }) lists them). The components draw roles ("ui.close", "ui.remove", "ui.expand"…; iconAliases()), each its glyph until the app registers the role: setIcons({ "ui.remove": … }) changes only the chips' ×. Sizes follow the font unless size; --ray-icon-size and --ray-icon-stroke tune the whole system.

PropertyAttributeTypeDefaultDescription
namename reflectsstringRegistered icon name (iconNames()); "none" draws nothing, a blank that keeps the alignment (a menu item without its check).
filledfilled reflectsbooleanThe filled version, for a state (active, selected, favorite, unread); the outline icon when there is none. Built in: user, info, circle-check, alert-triangle, circle-x, folder, bell, star, settings, home, message-circle.
mirrormirror reflectsbooleanMirrored in a right-to-left context (dir="rtl"), for an icon that points along the text: back, forward, send, undo. The roles that do (ui.next, ui.previous, ui.first, ui.last, ui.disclosure, ui.separator) mirror by themselves.
sizesize reflectsstringxs…xl or any CSS length. Default: 1em.
labellabelstringAccessible name; without it the icon is decorative (hidden from screen readers).
colorcolor reflectsstringA palette color or any CSS color. Default: the text color.
strokestrokenumberStroke width for stroke icons (default: --ray-icon-stroke, 2).
PartDescription
iconThe icon box.
